Wave 5b-2 selected SWC over oxc — no maintained oxc-parser-wasm npm package as of 2026-04-30; the unified oxc-parser package only ships native napi-rs bindings, which would require a Rust toolchain at install time and violate Fugazi's no-bundling design constraint.
